correctness.rationale: Exact derivative formula F prime=1+4 pi a B² cos(theta)(rho-sin(theta)). The only interior extrema of its negative lobes solve 2 sin²(theta)-rho sin(theta)-1=0, yielding the unique deep and, for rho<1, shallow minima. Their depths yield the sharp thresholds and 0/1/2/3/4 zero counts including endpoint degeneracy. At a fold birth g double prime=Delta sqrt(1-nu²)>0, proving cubic stationary inflection and the square-root displacement. Algebraic series prove the 3/2 divergence and linear symmetric splitting. Full analytic argument in RESULT.md, supplemented by 118 successful deterministic checks in check_turning.py.

value.rationale: Sharp global loss of invertibility is a natural structural invariant of a circle lift: it separates degree-one circle homeomorphisms (zero entropy) from maps with turning points. This exact all-parameter classification answers the original paper’s highlighted criticality difficulty, distinguishes one and two fold-birth mechanisms and the symmetric merger, and identifies a nontrivial divergent 3/2 fold-threshold near the one-lobe boundary. It does not confuse noninvertibility with chaos.
